title: At market open, Korean chipmakers' stocks plunged, with Samsung Electronics dropping 9%+, SK Hynix down 11%+, and the Korea Composite Stock Price Index down 8%+ (Youkyung Lee/Bloomberg)
summary: Youkyung Lee / Bloomberg: At market open, Korean chipmakers' stocks plunged, with Samsung Electronics dropping 9%+, SK Hynix down 11%+, and the Korea Composite Stock Price Index down 8%+ — South Korean stocks plunged, dragged by the nation's memory chipmaking powerhouses as investor sentiment continues to worsen on the artificial intelligence boom.
